name: Conti Ransomware Coverage (this project)
description: Coverage of Conti ransomware behaviour by Splunk security_content detections, scored from this project's evidence (matrix/coverage_matrix.json), not from Splunk's own (deprecated, ransomware-family-absent) mitre-map. Score 100=covered, 40=detection exists but its own logic does not match this capture, 10=behaviour occurred but Splunk ships no detection for it. Techniques not observed in this family's capture are omitted (GREY / no claim), not scored 0.

legendItems.label: RED-LOGIC: detection exists, logic does not match
RED-TELEMETRY: no detection shipped for this technique+family
